questions.prompt: Which city approved the Declaration of Independence in 1776?
questions.fact: The Declaration was approved on 4 July 1776, but most of the signatures were added weeks later, on 2 August.

questions.prompt: Which enzyme in saliva begins breaking down starch?
questions.fact: Digestion starts in the mouth. Hold a piece of bread on your tongue and it slowly turns sweet as amylase breaks starch into sugar.

questions.prompt: Freestyle and butterfly are strokes in which sport?
questions.fact: Butterfly began as a legal loophole in breaststroke. Swimmers exploited the rules until it was split off as its own stroke in 1952.

questions.prompt: Which pop star is known for the album 1989?
questions.fact: The album is named for her birth year, and marked a deliberate move from country to pop.

questions.prompt: Greenland is politically part of which kingdom?
questions.fact: Greenland is the world's largest island and governs itself, but remains part of the Kingdom of Denmark.

questions.prompt: Which desert planet is central to the novel 'Dune'?
questions.fact: The planet is worth fighting over because it is the only source of the spice that makes interstellar travel possible.

questions.prompt: Which type of display technology uses organic compounds that emit light?
questions.fact: Each pixel makes its own light, so switching one off gives true black — something a backlit LCD cannot do.
